announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.2.0
announcement.content:
Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.2.0 adds hostile relationship progression, theme-matched Maps, and a shorter Relationship Manager workflow.

  • Relationships can move into hostility with directional Rank Macros, Rank Down Event markers, hostile color settings, and signed API values.
  • All six themes now have matching Relationship Maps with separate image and framing controls for circular Map Nodes and right-hand detail portraits.
  • Per-theme settings can replace fonts and Rank cut-in messages, while a world display profile applies shared visual defaults.
  • Relationship Manager is divided into General, Progress, Images, and Records sections with larger tabs, preserved drafts, Note reordering, and optional Observer view-only access.
  • Fixes cover player Stat Card permissions, Relationship Map scaling, and Relationship Settings window layering.
